method: One entry per weapon in data/weapons.json (same 'name', same order). For each weapon every numeric, stat-like bonus in its effect text was mapped onto the planner stat vocabulary; purely mechanical lines (extra bounces, hit parts, super armor, ammo refills, proc damage of special sub-effects) go to 'mechanics'.

Where several text generations exist, 'effects' follow the NEWEST dated text (in-game card 2026-03 and CN sheet 2026-05 when they agree; meta-builds 2026-09 export when it is demonstrably post-rebalance, e.g. Corrosion). Superseded values from data/weapons.json are kept in the effect 'condition' or in 'notes' so nothing is lost. Each effect carries a 'source' array naming the text generation(s) it was read from.

Stacking effects: 'value' is the bonus at full stacks (steady state) = perStack x maxStacks = maxValue; divide by maxStacks for one stack. Non-stacking effects have perStack/maxStacks/maxValue null. Per-step effects whose step count depends on the build (magazine size, bomb delay) give the intrinsic step count in 'value' and the step size in 'perStack' with maxStacks null.
Percent values are percentage points. dmgVsPct with key 'player' and a negative value encodes 'deals X% DMG to Meta-Humans' for the named proc (condition says which).

triggerChancePct = stated chance per event of the kind named in 'triggerChanceBasis' ('hit' = per bullet/pellet that connects, 'shot' = per trigger pull, 'crit' / 'weakspot' = per crit or weakspot hit, 'cooldown' = cooldown-limited, converted to an equivalent per-hit chance at the weapon's base fire rate as explained in triggerRule). 'every N hits' = 100/N; guaranteed = 100; unknown = null. Always-on chance multipliers ('base chance +30%') are folded into triggerChancePct; conditional ones (after crit/kill/reload) are listed as statusChancePct effects (relative %, key = keyword) and must NOT be applied on top of an already-boosted figure.

keywordFactorOverridePct is null for every weapon: all 'X% of Attack / Psi' figures found in the texts are either the keyword's own (often outdated) base factor (Shrapnel 50%, Bounce 60%, Unstable Bomber 100%, Frost Vortex 30%/s, Burn 10%) or a separate sub-proc (Dragon's Breath 95% Attack, Hazardous Object throw, Hammerhead chain, Orb Lightning 75% Psi, Boom! Boom! explosion 300% Psi) recorded under mechanics - not an override of the keyword factor used for every proc.

Keyword base effects (Fast Gunner +1% Fire Rate/+1% Attack per stack x5; Fortress Warfare Heavy Armor Weapon DMG +20%; The Bull's Eye Vulnerability +8%) are NOT duplicated in weapon effects; the planner's keyword model should supply them.

extensions.keywordCritRatePct: crit rate granted to a keyword's procs (key = keyword), e.g. 'Power Surge Crit Rate +15%', 'Unstable Bomber can crit, Crit Rate +35%', 'guaranteed crit' = 100. Not in the base vocabulary; added because several weapons define it.
extensions.meleeDmgPct: Melee DMG % (melee weapons only). Added for Scourge and Crowbar.
extensions.effects[].source: array of text generations the effect was read from (see sources).
extensions.triggerChanceBasis: what triggerChancePct is a chance per: hit | shot | crit | weakspot | cooldown | melee ... (see method).

caveats: No game site was reachable; every number comes from GitHub-hosted mirrors, OCR of in-game screenshots, a Chinese community sheet (translated here) and quoted patch notes. Translation and OCR errors are possible (e.g. EBR-14 'Crit Rate +20%' vs 'Burn crit rate +20%').

data/weapons.json effect text is the 2024-25 OHDB wording for most weapons; 24 weapons have a newer in-game (2026-03) or CN (2026-05) text with different numbers. Entries list which generation each effect follows; confidence is 'medium' wherever generations disagree.

Keyword conflicts found: Compound Bow is an Unstable Bomber crossbow (weapons.json says Fortress Warfare with text that belongs to AWS.338 - Black Panther); AWS.338 - Black Panther is a Fortress Warfare sniper (weapons.json says Shrapnel with text copied from SOCR - The Last Valor); OIC-8 - Last Carnival's text is a copy of Critical Pulse (unverified). G17 - Hazardous Object, PDW90, SKS - Pathfinder, EBR-14, MPS5 - Primal Rage, DB12 - Backfire, DBSG - Dual Fury, Kukri, Scourge, Masamune, Crowbar, Frozen Northern Pike, Warning Sign, MGL have effects here although weapons.json lists no keyword/text for them.
KAM - Burning Rage may be an alias of KAM - Crank (CN name 怒火攻心); left empty to avoid double counting.
ACS12 - Corrosion: meta-builds (70% / PS Crit Rate +15% / PS Crit DMG +15% x10) is treated as the current v3.0.5+ text; the 2026-03 card showed 80% / +25% / +40% x5.
Shotgun 'per hit' chances (Corrosion, Pyroclasm, Doombringer, Backfire) are assumed per pellet; unverified.
'Reload Speed +X%' legacy wording was converted to Reload Efficiency at the official maximum ratio (+10% -> +3%); the raw value is kept in the quote.
Cooldown-based triggers (Abyss Glance, Little Jaws, Pathfinder) are expressed as an equivalent per-hit chance at the weapon's base fire rate; recompute if fire rate changes.
